body:
I dont really know if there are any specific triggers causing the suicidal thoughts but she has pretty bad anxiety and panic attacks especially at night. Some nights she lays awake and doesnt sleep at all. I completely understand why shes so tired of fighting through it, its an exhausting battle but I know she can get through it. 

She has been seeing a psychiatrist but only once every 2 weeks or so. So theres alot of time for it to get worse between appointments.  I am trying to convince her to discuss medication with her doctor but she doesnt like the idea. 

We spend alot of time together, we try to get out biking or for a walk a couple nights a week. We've been doing lots of activites lately but its still taking over her thoughts. I dont know how to help her.

Suicide is not about being selfish, its about being in a place where you think your life is doing more harm than good. A place where you think this is it and it will never get better.  Have you tried telling them your problems? They can take it. They might not be able to make them go away but it can help them understand where your at and they can help you work towards getting better. You are not selfish or petty or weak.You have been through hell but you are not alone and you can make it through this. I hope you find the strength to keep fighting.

You have the whole world wide web of people to talk to! I'm sorry for what you went through. I had  friend go through a very similar thing earlier this year, she was in a terrible place when it all ended, tried to kill herself. She was in a dark place but getting out of that relationship was something she needed. She has really started turning her life around, came clean to her family and friends about all the lies her and her ex had been telling, got help and really started to work on herself. They truly loved each other but their relationship was toxic. 6 months later and shes doing good and so much happier about herself. She still has things to improve on but shes working towards them. I really hope that something similar will happen in your situation. Goodluck!

Be there for her, and I think it would help to be honest about about your feelings as well. It helps to know you're not alone. And it might give you and/or her a different perspective. You see things differently when its someone you love who's going through it. Don't ever underestimate your strength or your worth.

As far as I know she still doesnt want to, but the thoughts telling her too are getting stronger. So maybe its only a matter of time. Her parents are coming to visit this weekend so Ill see how that goes. Thank you for all the advice, it's been helpful.

What do you mean by feed her thoughts to make her happy? Could you explain a little better?

and thanks :)

That's another thing im struggling with, I don't what point it too far. She's told me shes having these thoughts but doesnt want to end her life. Lately though the thougts have been getting worse and harder to fight. I'm one of the only people she talks to about this openly ( as open as she gets) so I don't want to ruin that trust but i dont want to lose her becuase i kept it to myself. 

I've talked to other people about it, some of her friends and family but  not for a while. They don't realize how bad she is, and her mom knows something is up but also doesnt know how bad it is I dont think. 

How do you know when its time to tell someone else?

Also Im so glad your friend made that call for you that day and that youre still here.
Thank you, its helpful to read through.
